content.title: Pokémon Champions is coming to Nintendo Switch on 8 April. | News & Updates | Nintendo
content.text: 6 April 2026Nintendo Switch 2Nintendo SwitchPokémon Champions is coming to Nintendo Switch on 8 April. Pokémon Champions is a brand-new, free-to-start game that focuses on all the strategy and fun of Pokémon battles! Made for both new and experienced Trainers alike, the game features familiar mechanics such as Pokémon types, Abilities, and moves. You also won't need to wait long to play: Pokémon Champions comes out 8 April. Additionally, a free update for Nintendo Switch 2 owners will provide even clearer graphics. Please watch the video for a deeper look at the game. ©Pokémon/Nintendo/Creatures/GAME FREAK Pokémon and Nintendo Switch are trademarks of Nintendo. This is a free-to-start game. A Pokémon Champions + Starter Pack bundle, as well as optional in-game items, will be available to purchase.
